records.title: Personal Knowledge and Study Retrieval System
records.goal: Solve the learner's own problem of scattered notes and unreliable retrieval by building a small personal system that makes useful knowledge findable and testable.
deliverables: A personal use-case and friction log
A small structured knowledge collection with stable IDs and source provenance
A searchable or navigable index (paper, spreadsheet or local digital format)
Retrieval prompts and a delayed-recall record
A short change log and reflection
acceptance_criteria: Solves a documented personal retrieval problem rather than merely looking organised.
A note can be found from a realistic query and traced to its source where applicable.
Retrieval prompts test understanding rather than recognition alone.
The system remains small enough to maintain; unused complexity is removed.
Delayed retrieval is reported honestly and not confused with app usage.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Do not store passwords, recovery codes, private messages or sensitive personal data.
Use local/offline storage; do not upload private notes to public AI services.
No need to collect data about other people.

records.title: Personal Football Performance Feedback Loop
records.goal: Improve one chosen football performance weakness using observable evidence, safe practice design and recovery-aware iteration.
deliverables: A narrow performance question and baseline observation
A simple action/cue observation rubric
A short practice plan with warm-up, workload and recovery boundaries
A practice log with contextual notes
A post-practice comparison and next-step decision
acceptance_criteria: The target is a controllable behaviour with an observable definition.
Baseline and follow-up use sufficiently similar conditions and note confounders.
Practice is age-appropriate, technique-led and includes rest.
The conclusion does not claim causation from a tiny sample.
The next action follows evidence and personal readiness, not pressure.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: No maximal testing, punishment conditioning or training through pain.
Avoid recording identifiable bystanders; obtain permission before filming or sharing.
No diagnosis or individualized medical claims; seek a trusted adult/qualified professional for injury or health concerns.

records.title: Personal Money and Small-Business Record System
records.goal: Improve the learner's own understanding of small cash movements and business unit economics using accurate, privacy-conscious records.
deliverables: A fictional or permissioned transaction dataset
A transparent ledger with categories and reconciliation
A unit-economics worksheet separating revenue, direct cost and contribution
A cash-flow summary and assumptions note
A privacy and error-check checklist
acceptance_criteria: Revenue, cash balance, cost and profit/contribution are not conflated.
Transactions reconcile to the supplied dataset and exceptions are visible.
Private customer and account data are excluded.
Assumptions and missing costs are explicit.
No investment, tax or legal recommendation is produced.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: A minor must not independently handle regulated financial activity, tax filings, contracts or customer payment credentials.
Real business data require explicit owner/guardian permission and anonymisation.
No high-risk investing, borrowing, crypto trading or financial promotion.

records.title: Household Workflow Improvement
records.goal: Reduce friction in one low-risk household task through observation, a reversible change and a fair before/after comparison.
deliverables: A description of the current process
A simple process map and friction observation
A proposed reversible change
A before/after comparison using a modest measure
A household handoff note and reflection
acceptance_criteria: The selected process is genuinely used and low risk.
The change is reversible and does not transfer hidden work or risk to others.
The comparison uses a consistent measure and records context.
Household members' privacy and preferences are respected.
The handoff is understandable to the person who will use it.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Do not mix cleaning chemicals or use hazardous tools.
Do not alter shared spaces or discard belongings without permission.
Stop and ask an adult for electrical, gas, plumbing, heavy lifting or repair issues.

records.title: Bangla–English Personal Technical Glossary
records.goal: Solve a real comprehension problem by building a small, concept-accurate bilingual glossary for terms encountered in current study.
deliverables: A list of 20–30 encountered terms
Concept definitions in plain language in both languages
Examples, diagrams or counterexamples for difficult terms
A note on non-equivalent translations and context
A short self-test and correction log
acceptance_criteria: Entries explain concepts rather than provide bare word substitutions.
Technical meaning remains stable across both languages.
Ambiguous terms show context and non-equivalence explicitly.
Sources can be traced and quotations are attributed.
Delayed self-test exposes gaps rather than being pre-filled.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Do not copy entire textbook passages or copyrighted dictionaries; paraphrase and cite.
Avoid collecting classmates' private mistakes or personal data.

records.title: Personal Digital Safety and Backup Drill
records.goal: Reduce the learner's own risk of losing important non-sensitive files or compromising accounts through a documented, reversible safety routine.
deliverables: A personal data inventory excluding secrets
A file organisation and naming convention
A backup plan with at least one independent copy
A test restore of dummy or non-sensitive files
A short account/device safety checklist
acceptance_criteria: A test restore succeeds for selected dummy files.
Backup copy is independent enough to reduce a realistic failure mode.
No secrets or unnecessary personal data are stored in the artefact.
The procedure is reversible and avoids destructive commands.
Limitations and residual risks are documented.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Never share passwords, OTPs, recovery phrases or private keys.
Do not run destructive shell commands or factory reset as part of the project.
Ask a guardian before changing account recovery or device security settings.

records.title: Tiny Digital Product: Problem-to-Prototype Validation
records.goal: Build a useful, narrowly scoped digital product prototype around an evidenced user problem and establish a credible path to future improvement, packaging and possible sale without assuming commercial success.
deliverables: Problem and user-evidence brief
One end-to-end prototype for a narrow task
Acceptance tests and usability observations
Basic cost/time/capacity model with assumptions
Privacy/threat checklist using dummy data
Decision memo: continue, change, pause or stop
acceptance_criteria: The product completes one defined user task end-to-end.
User/problem evidence is consent-based and appropriately limited.
Prototype tests include normal and boundary cases.
Sensitive real user data and unnecessary collection are avoided.
Costs, time and support burden are stated separately from revenue.
A stop/change decision is accepted as a valid result.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Public release, contracts, paid services, spending, customer accounts and handling real payments require guardian involvement and applicable legal checks.
Do not collect sensitive personal data, scrape sites, spam, mislead users or test systems without permission.
Do not promise income or claim product-market fit.

records.title: Small Inventory and Sales Operations Tool
records.goal: Create a reliable internal tool or spreadsheet for a small lawful product operation, with reconciled inventory, sales and unit economics.
deliverables: Data dictionary and workflow map
Spreadsheet or local prototype
Test dataset and edge-case suite
Inventory reconciliation report
Unit economics summary
User guide and rollback plan
acceptance_criteria: Inventory changes reconcile to the test ledger.
Revenue, direct cost, contribution and cash timing remain distinct.
Duplicate, refund and correction cases are tested.
Access is limited to appropriate users; customer data are not required.
The tool includes backup/export and correction procedures.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Do not use customer names, phone numbers, credentials or payment card data.
Real deployment or business process changes require owner/guardian approval.
No automated payment processing or financial-account integration in the learning prototype.

records.title: Customer-Support Knowledge Base for a Small Service
records.goal: Create a trustworthy support knowledge base that reduces repeated explanations for a small lawful service while preserving accuracy and escalation boundaries.
deliverables: Top-question inventory based on observed or fictional scenarios
Verified answer articles with sources and last-checked dates
Search/navigation structure
Escalation and uncertainty rules
Comprehension test and revision log
acceptance_criteria: Every factual answer has a traceable source or is clearly labelled as a proposed policy.
Outdated and uncertain information is marked for review.
Sensitive customer details are excluded.
Escalation routes exist for payment, safety, legal or account-specific issues.
Users can find and understand answers without misleading guarantees.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Do not publish customer conversations or identifiable complaints.
Do not invent refund, warranty, legal or platform policies.
A minor must not independently represent a business in contracts or public commitments.

records.title: Ethical Offer and Market Evidence Experiment
records.goal: Test whether a clearly described, lawful offer solves a real problem using low-cost, consent-based evidence and a defined stop rule.
deliverables: Problem hypothesis and target-user description
Interview or observation protocol with consent
Offer statement with scope and exclusions
Cost/time and capacity assumptions
Predefined success and stop thresholds
Results and decision memo
acceptance_criteria: Hypotheses can be contradicted by observations.
Sampling and consent are described; sample limits are acknowledged.
Offer claims and terms are clear and non-deceptive.
Costs, capacity and risk are included; spending has prior approval.
A stop rule is written before results are known.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: No independent contracts, paid ads, customer data processing, borrowing or payment collection by a minor.
Guardian approval before any spending, public offer, transaction or business commitment.
No deceptive marketing, pressure, spam or collection of sensitive data.

records.title: Small Educational Product: Teach One Skill Well
records.goal: Create a small educational product prototype that helps a defined learner perform one narrow skill, with evidence of learning rather than content volume.
deliverables: One target learner/outcome statement
A short explanation with worked example
Guided and independent practice items
Answer/feedback guidance and misconception checks
A small pilot record using consent and no sensitive data
Revision and packaging note
acceptance_criteria: The material teaches a specific observable outcome.
Practice is aligned to the outcome and includes feedback.
A pilot tests performance, not just whether the learner liked it.
Sources and reused assets are attributed and licensing is respected.
Packaging does not imply guaranteed results or expert certification.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Do not collect learner health, identity or sensitive personal data.
Do not claim accredited status or guaranteed outcomes.
Use only assets with suitable permissions; link to sources instead of copying restricted material.

records.title: Service Delivery Workflow and Quality Checklist
records.goal: Design a repeatable, low-risk service workflow that makes scope, quality checks, handoff and revision predictable.
deliverables: Service scope and exclusion statement
Workflow with roles and handoff points
Quality checklist and error log
Time/capacity estimate
Customer-safe communication template
Revision and escalation procedure
acceptance_criteria: Scope and exclusions prevent ambiguous promises.
Workflow has clear ownership and handoff criteria.
Quality checks catch plausible errors before delivery.
Capacity estimates include revision and support time.
Privacy and escalation rules are proportionate.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: No real client commitments, contracts, paid work or sensitive records without guardian involvement and legal checks.
Do not promise outcomes beyond current capability.
Do not automate decisions affecting other people without human review.

records.title: Visual Form and Light Exploration Series
records.goal: Explore how line, shape, perspective, light and composition change the visual character of an image, without requiring a client, utility or commercial outcome.
deliverables: A self-chosen series of sketches or photographs
A small experiment log noting the variable explored
Selected iterations and discarded attempts
A short artist/research reflection on discoveries and unresolved questions
acceptance_criteria: The learner explores a self-chosen visual question.
Multiple variations make the exploration visible.
Observations distinguish visible evidence from interpretation.
The series includes iteration and a reflection on discoveries.
No audience approval, public release, client use or commercial value is required.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Use only safe locations and materials; do not trespass or photograph people without appropriate permission.
Avoid unsafe heights, traffic or hazardous lighting setups.

records.title: Electronics Curiosity Lab: Diodes, Signals and Surprises
records.goal: Explore selected electronics phenomena through diagrams, simulations or verified safe low-voltage kits, driven by curiosity rather than a required product.
deliverables: A curiosity question or prediction
Circuit sketches or simulator screenshots
A small set of observations or simulation results
A record of surprising results and revised explanations
A list of new questions
acceptance_criteria: A clear question and pre-observation prediction exist.
The exploration stays within verified safe low-voltage conditions or simulation.
Observations are recorded with units/context where applicable.
The learner revises or qualifies a model when evidence conflicts.
No functioning device, sale or practical utility is required.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Never use mains electricity, wall adapters of unknown quality, exposed high-energy sources, modified lithium cells or improvised power supplies.
No soldering or physical circuit assembly without appropriate adult supervision and safe components.
Do not bypass safety features.

records.title: Original Micro-World or Visual Narrative
records.goal: Create an original fictional world, character study or visual narrative to explore ideas, atmosphere and form for its own sake.
deliverables: A self-chosen premise, mood or visual question
Character/place/prop sketches or notes
A short sequence, scene, comic, audio fragment or prose experiment
Alternative versions and a reflection on artistic choices
acceptance_criteria: The work is recognisably the learner's own creative exploration.
Choices of form, sequence or language are intentional enough to discuss.
At least one alternative or revision is preserved.
Existing media references are acknowledged; no copying or impersonation.
No audience, utility, publication or monetisation requirement exists.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Do not imitate a living creator's exact style; use broad formal qualities and original choices.
Respect copyright and privacy when using references, images or voices.
Do not publish personal information or other people's likenesses without permission.

records.title: Mathematical Pattern Hunt
records.goal: Investigate a mathematical pattern or conjecture because it is interesting, using examples, representations and counterexamples without requiring a practical application.
deliverables: A pattern question or conjecture
A table, drawing, graph or small program exploring examples
A counterexample search
A distinction between observed pattern and proven statement
A note on next questions
acceptance_criteria: The question is mathematically meaningful and learner-chosen.
Examples and representations are accurate.
At least one deliberate attempt to find a counterexample is made.
Conjecture, evidence and proof are not conflated.
A useful unresolved question remains visible.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: No special safety risk; avoid exposing private data in online calculators or code tools.

records.title: Sound, Rhythm and Voice Curiosity Study
records.goal: Explore sound, rhythm, pitch, phrasing or vocal colour in a comfortable, self-directed way without performance or audience requirements.
deliverables: A self-chosen listening or sound question
Short comfortable recordings or rhythm sketches
A comparison of variations
Notes on perception and what was difficult to hear
A next-curiosity list
acceptance_criteria: Exploration is self-chosen and bounded.
Experiments are comfortable and do not involve vocal strain.
One parameter is compared at a time where practical.
Listening observations are specific and open to uncertainty.
No public performance, polished recording or audience approval is required.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Stop if pain, hoarseness, dizziness or strain occurs; do not force range or volume.
Keep playback volume safe; recording is optional and private by default.

records.title: Language and Script Curiosity Atlas
records.goal: Explore how languages or writing systems encode sound, meaning and structure through a self-chosen comparison, without requiring fluency or a practical deliverable.
deliverables: A self-chosen linguistic question
Examples from credible sources or voluntarily supplied language material
A small annotated map/table/visual atlas
Notes on exceptions and limits
A reflection and next questions
acceptance_criteria: The comparison is specific and curious rather than ranking languages.
Examples have traceable sources and context.
Claims avoid overgeneralising from a small sample.
The atlas makes a real structural difference visible.
No fluency, utility, public audience or monetisation is required.
records.review_notes: Wave 09 working proposal. Project-class semantics and objective mappings require later discipline-owner and learner review; completion does not confer mastery.
safety_requirements: Do not record or publish other people's speech without consent.
Avoid stereotypes, ranking languages or inferring identity from language use.
Respect copyright and source terms.
